name: Chicken Tenders with Tangy Japanese Tonkatsu Sauce & Nutty Kale Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Place bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the breading mixture and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice lengthwise into 1-inch strips. Place in a large bowl along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add breading mixture to the bowl with the chicken and toss to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Divide chicken between the baking sheets and arrange in a single layer. (Reserve small bowl for later use.)
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads napa cabbage
1 ½ bunches kale
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Place peanut butter, oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 tbsp rice vinegar
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root end of each cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces; add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale and cabbage with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved small bowl, along with ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Whisk to combine the tonkatsu sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide chicken tenders and slaw between plates. Serve with tonkatsu sauce for dipping and enjoy!
